verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਖਾ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)gat sakhaa milaap gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd jugat kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: The method of meeting with the Lord God through meditation in a holy gathering is like the gathering and formation of clouds that cause rain, lightening and thunder.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਗਰਜਤ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh keeratan gur sabadh kai anahadh naadh garajat unamaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Acquiring a stable state of contemplation and meditation in the holy congregation, the continuous melody that is heard within should be regarded as sound of thunder of the clouds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)gat jotee saroop dhaaminee chamatakaar unaman maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: The divine light that radiates during stable state meditation in the holy gathering is like miraculous lightening that blossoms the mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੨੮॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh liv nijhar apaar dhaar barakhaa a(n)mirat jal sarab nidhaaneeaai ||128||

en.bdb: The continuous flow of the elixir of Naam that takes place in the tenth door of the body as a result of meditation in the congregation of holy men is like rain of nectar that is the treasure house of all the boons. (128)
